label: Existence.of.SOLA
title: \bf Theorem
body_md:
\label{Existence.of.SOLA}
Assume that \eqref{p} holds. There exists a constant $\kappa_0=\kappa_0(n,p,\Lambda)>0$ such that if $[\log\mathbb{M}]_{\operatorname{BMO}_{R_0}(\mathbb{R}^n)}\le \kappa_0$ for some $R_0>0$, there is a SOLA to \eqref{main.eq}.

label: theo:main
title: \bf Theorem
body_md:
\label{theo:main}
    Assume that \eqref{p} holds and let $1<q<\infty$. There exists a constant ${\kappa}={\kappa}(n, p,\Lambda)>0$ such that if
$$[\log\mathbb{M}]_{\operatorname{BMO}_{R_0}(\mathbb{R}^n)}<\frac{{\kappa}}{q}$$
for some $R_0>0$, then for any SOLA $u$ to \eqref{main.eq}, we have 
\begin{equation}\label{main.thm.est}
\fint_{B_R} (|\mathbb{M}|^{\frac{1}{p-1}}|\mathbb{M}Du| )^q \,dx
\le
c\,\left(\fint_{B_{2R}}|\mathbb{M}|^{\frac{1}{p-1}}|\mathbb{M}Du|\,dx\right)^q
+
c\fint_{B_{2R}} (\mathcal{M}_1(\mu) )^{\frac{q}{p-1}}\,dx
\end{equation}
for every ball $B_{2R}\Subset\Omega$ and $2R\le R_0$, where $c=c(n,p,q,\Lambda)>0$.

label: lem.oM
title: \bf Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem.oM}
For a matrix-valued weight $\mathbb{M}$ and $\omega=|\mathbb{M}|$, there holds
$$
\fint_B\left|\log \omega(x)-\langle \log \omega\rangle_B\right|\,dx
\leq
2\fint_B
\left|\log \mathbb{M}(x)-\langle \log \mathbb{M}\rangle_B\right|\,dx.
$$
Moreover,
$$
{[\log \omega]_{\operatorname{BMO}(B)}}
 \le 2{[\log\mathbb{M}]_{\operatorname{BMO}(B)}}.
$$

label: lem.JNL
title: \bf Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem.JNL}
There exist constants $\gamma=\gamma(n,\Lambda)>0$ and $c=c(n,\Lambda)>0$ such that the following holds. If $s\ge 1$ and $\mathbb{M}$ is a matrix-valued weight with ${[\log\mathbb{M}]_{\operatorname{BMO}(B)}} \leq \frac{\gamma}{s},$
then
$$
\left(\fint_B\left(\frac{\bigl|\mathbb{M}-\langle \mathbb{M}\rangle_B^{\log}\bigr|}{|\langle \mathbb{M}\rangle_B^{\log}|}\right)^s\,dx\right)^{\frac{1}{s}}
\leq
c s {[\log\mathbb{M}]_{\operatorname{BMO}(B)}}.
$$
The same holds with $\mathbb{M}$ replaced by a scalar weight $\omega$.

label: lem:logBMO
title: \bf Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem:logBMO}
There exists a constant $\gamma=\gamma(n,\Lambda)>0$ such that the following hold for all weights $\omega$.
\begin{enumerate}[(a)]
\item If $[\log\omega]_{\mathrm{BMO}(B)}\le \dfrac{\gamma}{s}$ with $s\ge 1$, then
$$
\left(\fint_B \omega^{s}\,dx\right)^{\frac1s}\le 2\,\langle \omega\rangle^{\log}_{B}.
$$

\item If $[\log\omega]_{\mathrm{BMO}(B)}\le \dfrac{\gamma}{s}$ with $s\ge 1$, then
$$
\left(\fint_B \omega^{-s}\,dx\right)^{\frac1s}\le \frac{2}{\langle \omega\rangle^{\log}_{B}}.
$$

\item If $[\log\omega]_{\mathrm{BMO}(B)}\le \gamma\min\!\left\{\frac1p,\frac1{p'}\right\}$
with $1<p<\infty$, then $\omega^p$ is an $\mathcal{A}_p(B)$-Muckenhoupt weight and
$$
[\omega^p]_{\mathcal{A}_p(B)}^{\frac{1}{p}} =
\sup_{B'\subset B}
\left(\fint_{B'}\omega^{p}\,dx\right)^{\frac1p}
\left(\fint_{B'}\omega^{-p'}\,dx\right)^{\frac1{p'}}
\le 4.
$$

\item Let $1<p<\infty$ and $\theta\in(0,1)$ such that $\theta p>1$.
If $[\log\omega]_{\mathrm{BMO}(B)}\le \gamma\min\!\left\{\frac1p,\;1-\frac{1}{\theta p}\right\}$,
then
$$
\sup_{B'\subset B}
\left(\fint_{B'}\omega^{p}\,dx\right)^{\frac1p}
\left(\fint_{B'}\omega^{-(\theta p)'}\,dx\right)^{\frac1{(\theta p)'}}
\le 4.
$$
\end{enumerate}

label: lem-iteration
title: \bf Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem-iteration}
Let $\phi$ be a bounded nonnegative function on $[r_1,r_2]$. Suppose that for any
$s_1,s_2$ with $0< r_1 \le s_1 < s_2 \le r_2$,
$$
\phi(s_1)\le \eta \phi(s_2) + \frac{c_1}{(s_2-s_1)^{\alpha}} + c_2,
$$
where $\alpha, c_1, c_2 \ge 0$ and $\eta \in (0,1)$. Then for any
$r_1 \le s_1 < s_2 \le r_2$, it holds that
$$
\phi(r_1)\le c\left[\frac{c_1}{(r_2-r_1)^{\alpha}} + c_2\right]
$$
for some $c=c(\eta,\alpha)>0$.

label: covering
title: \bf Lemma
body_md:
\label{covering}
Let 
\begin{equation*}\label{513}
\lambda>A\lambda_0,\; where \;\;A := \left(\frac{{60}}{t_2-t_1}\right)^{n}.
\end{equation*}
 Then there exists a countable family of pairwise disjoint balls
$\{B_{R_i}(x_i)\}_{i\ge1}$ with $x_i\in B_{t_1 R}$ and $0< R_i \le \frac{(t_2-t_1)R}{{30}}$ such that
$$
E(t_1,\lambda)\setminus \mathcal{N} \subset \bigcup_{i=1}^{\infty} B_{5R_i}(x_i)
\subset B_{t_2 R},
$$
where \(\mathcal{N}\subset \mathbb{R}^n\) is a Lebesgue measure zero set.
Moreover, for each \(i\in\mathbb{N}\),
\begin{equation}\label{514}
\fint_{B_{R_i}(x_i)} |{\mathbb{A}(Du)}|\,dx
+\frac{1}{\tau}\fint_{B_{R_i}(x_i)} \left(\mathcal{M}_1(\mu)\right)^\frac{1}{p-1}\,dx
=\lambda,
\end{equation}
and 
\begin{equation}\label{515}
\fint_{B_{\rho}(x_i)} |{\mathbb{A}(Du)}|\,dx
+\frac{1}{\tau}\fint_{B_{\rho}(x_i)} \left(\mathcal{M}_1(\mu)\right)^\frac{1}{p-1}\,dx
<\lambda,
\end{equation}
for every $\rho\in\left(R_i,(t_2-t_1)R\right]$.
